The bundled "Mandela" extension: Espresso's support for the desktop's own scripting language.
MandelaUserscriptsExtension
Mandela userscripts: the Web Browser's side of the desktop scripting language.
MarkdownTools
The bundled "Markdown Tools" extension: toggles inline Markdown emphasis on the selection (bold, italic, inline code) and bullet-list markers across the selected lines, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Markdown category.
MavenBuildTools
The Maven extension: runs the lifecycle goals of the Maven project that owns the current document.
MediaItem
One entry of the audio player's library / playlist: a local file, a network stream, an AM/FM or internet radio station, or a podcast episode.
MediaItem.Kind
What an entry points at.
MediaWriter
The Media Writer application: the MediaWriterPanel (burn ISO to CD/DVD, write a raw image or ISO to a USB key, clone a disc/device, format a removable key, or build a data disc) presented as an integrated 3D desktop window via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the Swing panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
MediaWriterEngine
Headless engine behind MediaWriterPanel: enumerates real block and optical devices and drives real burn / image / format operations by shelling out to the standard Linux media tools (dd, wodim/ cdrecord, growisofs, xorriso, mkfs.*, isohybrid, wipefs, parted).
MediaWriterEngine.DeviceInfo
A detected device (whole disk, optical drive or removable key).
MediaWriterEngine.DeviceKind
Physical class of a detected device.
MediaWriterEngine.ImageInfo
Static facts about a selected image file.
MediaWriterEngine.MediaMode
The operations the panel exposes.
MediaWriterEngine.MediaWriterException
Thrown for any invalid request or failed operation.
MediaWriterEngine.ProgressHandler
Callbacks for a running operation.
MediaWriterPanel
Swing content of the Media Writer desktop window: burn an ISO to CD/DVD, write a raw image or ISO to a USB key, clone a disc/device, format a removable key, or build a data disc from a folder.
MergingUndoManager
The editor's undo stack: a bounded UndoManager that merges a burst of single-character typing into one undo step, so Ctrl+Z removes the word you just typed rather than one letter at a time, while every other edit (paste, replace-all, delete, programmatic insert) stays atomic on its own.
Messenger
The Instant Messenger application: the MessengerPanel multi-protocol chat client presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
MessengerClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the messenger panel, for running the client outside the desktop (e.g.
MessengerPanel
The Instant Messenger's Swing face: a multi-protocol chat client.
MessengerProtocol
A chat-network backend.
MessengerProtocol.Capability
Optional features a backend may support; the UI adapts to these.
MessengerSettings
User-facing, customisable preferences for the Messenger, persisted as JSON by MessengerStore.
MessengerStore
JSON persistence for the Messenger: the saved accounts, the message history and the MessengerSettings.
MultihomeRMIClientSocketFactory
 
MusicBrainzDiscId
Computes a MusicBrainz disc ID from a Toc.
MyLabel
 
MyTextField
 
NavigationDecision
An extension's verdict on a NavigationRequest: proceed, block, or proceed against a different URL.
NavigationDecision.Action
The three possible verdicts.
NavigationRequest
An immutable navigation about to happen, offered to extensions through BrowserExtension.onNavigate(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.NavigationRequest) so they may allow, block or redirect it.
NetworkPanel
Network panel (Phase 3 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.4).
NewImageDialog
The File → New dialog: canvas width/height and a background colour.
NoiseXXHandshake
A Noise-XX-style handshake: three messages that mutually authenticate two long-term X25519 identities and agree a pair of forward-secret, direction-separated AES-256-GCM keys, with no third-party dependency.
NoiseXXHandshake.CipherKeys
The immutable result of a completed handshake.
NoiseXXHandshake.Role
Which side of the exchange this instance plays.
Note
An immutable value object mapping a detected pitch frequency to the nearest equal-tempered note: its letter name (with sharps), octave, MIDI number, the ideal reference frequency of that note and the deviation of the detected pitch from it in cents (-50..+50).
NotificationsPanel
Notifications panel: the Do Not Disturb switch and the live notification log, over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
OpenApiEditor
Start-Menu launcher for the external OpenAPI Contract Editor: a full-featured YAML/OpenAPI specification editor (RSyntaxTextArea, swagger-parser validation, OpenAPI Generator code generation, endpoint tree, structure navigator) that ships as a self-contained fat jar (libs/openapi-editor.jar).
OpenMeteo
The AWT-free weather backend of the Weather app: it talks to the free Open-Meteo forecast API (no API key, no third-party library) exactly like the desktop's Weather widget does, using only the JDK's HttpClient and a small dependency-free JSON reader.
OpenMeteo.City
A location: a display name, an optional country, and WGS-84 coordinates.
OpenMeteo.Current
The current conditions block of a OpenMeteo.Report.
OpenMeteo.Day
One day of the daily forecast: an ISO date, its extremes and sky.
OpenMeteo.Report
A parsed weather report for one location.
OpenMeteo.Sky
The coarse sky family used to pick a glyph.
P2pCrypto
The AWT-free cryptographic seam of the encrypted peer-to-peer transport.
P2pMessage
The CONTROL-plane message that rides inside a SecureFrame.Type.CONTROL frame, serialised as JSON by Jackson.
P2pMessage.Kind
What a CONTROL message signals.
P2pNode
One participant in the encrypted peer-to-peer mesh: a long-term identity, an inbound P2pServer, outbound dialling, and a peer map.
P2pNode.Listener
Observes node-level events.
P2pNode.Peer
One connected peer: its identity fingerprint, learned nickname, the live SecureChannel and the FileTransferManager bound to it.
P2pNode.PeerVerifier
Decides whether a peer with a given fingerprint may join the mesh.
P2pProtocol
The native, in-process peer-to-peer backend: encrypted direct chat, presence and file transfer between LG3D nodes with no server in between, built on the reusable org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p transport (X25519 + a Noise-XX-style handshake + AES-256-GCM, forward-secret and mutually authenticated).
P2pServer
The inbound half of a P2P node: a ServerSocket plus a daemon accept loop.
P2pServer.ChannelAcceptor
Turns an accepted socket into a live, authenticated SecureChannel.
P2pSideChannel
The Video Conference app's encrypted peer-to-peer side-channel: a thin controller over the shared apps.p2p transport (P2pNode + LanDiscovery + IdentityStore) that carries meeting signaling, chat and file transfer between peers.
P2pSideChannel.Listener
The event sink for the side-channel.
PageContext
A loaded page, handed to extensions through BrowserExtension.onPageLoaded(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.PageContext) as the content-script injection point.
PaintApp
Entry point for the Paint app.
PaintCanvas
The drawing surface.
PaintContext
Everything a Tool needs while it works: the PaintDocument, the PaintState tool settings, the current Selection, and a PaintContext.Callback back to PaintCanvas for repaints, dialogs and selection notifications.
PaintContext.Callback
The canvas-side services a tool may call.
PaintDocument
The Paint document model: an ordered stack of PaintLayers over a background colour, a cached composite for fast repaint, structural editing (add/delete/reorder/duplicate/merge/flatten), whole-image transforms (resize/crop/rotate/flip) and a bounded undo history.
PaintDocument.Listener
Notified whenever the document changes so the UI can repaint/refresh.
PaintDocument.Snapshot
An immutable deep copy of the whole document, for snapshot edits.
PaintFrame
The Paint application window: a conventional JFrame with a full menu bar (File / Edit / Image / Layer / Select / View / Filter / Help), a tool + options toolbar, the PaintCanvas in a scroll pane, the LayerPanel on the right and a StatusBar at the bottom.
PaintIcons
Runtime-drawn toolbox icons.
PaintIO
File I/O for the Paint app: Open / Save / Save-As through a JFileChooser backed by ImageIO for PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP.
PaintLayer
A single raster layer of a PaintDocument: an ARGB BufferedImage plus the presentation attributes the compositor honours (name, visibility, opacity and blend mode).
PaintLayer.BlendMode
How a layer's pixels combine with what is already beneath it.
PaintState
The mutable tool settings shared by every Tool: the active tool, foreground/background colours, stroke geometry, tool opacity, font, shape fill/stroke flags, flood-fill tolerance, zoom and the antialiasing switch.
Particle
 
PasswordEntry
One credential in the vault: a title, the login / username, the secret itself, an optional URL and free-form notes, filed under a category.
PasswordManager
The Password Manager application: the PasswordManagerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
PasswordManagerClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the Password Manager panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.passwordmanager.PasswordManagerClient).
PasswordManagerPanel
The Password Manager's user interface: a lock card (create a master password the first time, or unlock an existing vault) and a vault card with a searchable entry list, a detail editor, a password generator and a settings tab.
PasswordManagerSettings
The Password Manager's persisted preferences: the auto-lock timeout, the password-generator policy (length and which character classes to include), whether secrets are masked by default, and the last category filter used.
PasswordVault
The unlocked, in-memory vault: an ordered list of PasswordEntry items with the small amount of behaviour the panel needs (add / remove / replace / filter / distinct categories) and the JSON (de)serialisation that VaultEnvelope seals.
PayloadMan
Start-Menu launcher for the external PayloadMan project (built from the tests-suite repository): a production-grade desktop API testing tool (HTTP request builder, collections, environments, auth, history, cookie jar, collection runner, cURL export) that ships as a self-contained fat jar (libs/payloadman.jar).
PdfDocument
The PDF backend of the PdfViewerPanel: an Apache PDFBox (Apache-2.0) adapter that rasterises one page at a time to a BufferedImage.
PdfViewer
The PDF Viewer application: the PdfViewerPanel document reader presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
PdfViewerPanel
A plain-Swing PDF reader: the 2D/Swing desktop face of the PDF Viewer.
PencilTool
A hard-edged, single-pixel freehand pencil.
Permission
A capability an extension declares in its ExtensionManifest and that the user must grant (through the extension manager) before the matching hook or BrowserContext capability becomes live.
PhotoItem
One photo in the viewer's library: an absolute file path, an optional title, a set of free-form tags and a 0..5 star rating.
PhotoLibrary
The photo viewer's library model: an ordered collection of PhotoItems plus the pure query logic the gallery needs (de-duplicated insertion by path, tag / keyword / rating filtering and the union of all tags).
PhotoViewer
The photo viewer application: the PhotoViewerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
PhotoViewerClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the photo viewer panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.photoviewer.PhotoViewerClient).
PhotoViewerPanel
The photo viewer's user interface: a thumbnail gallery with tag / keyword / rating filters on the left, a large preview with previous / next navigation on the right, and a tag-and-rating editor along the bottom.
PhotoViewerStore
JSON persistence for the photo viewer's library of tagged images.
PitchDetector
A time-domain fundamental-frequency estimator using the YIN algorithm (de Cheveigné & Kawahara, 2002), the standard autocorrelation-based pitch detector for monophonic instrument tuning.
PitchDetector.Pitch
The result of one detection: a fundamental frequency in Hz and a periodicity confidence in [0, 1].
PlayerSettings
The audio player's persisted preferences: master volume, an optional preferred external player (blank means auto-detect), and the repeat / shuffle toggles.
Playlist
The audio player's ordered library and playback cursor: an AWT-free model of "what plays next".
PolygonTool
Click-to-place polygon.
PopupBlockerExtension
A first-party reference extension, and the canonical example of the BrowserExtension SPI: it suppresses popups that were not triggered by a direct user gesture (the classic window.open-on-load ad), while letting user-initiated popups through.
PopupDecision
The two possible verdicts on a PopupRequest.
PopupRequest
A popup (a window.open or target=_blank request) about to be opened, offered to extensions through BrowserExtension.onPopup(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.PopupRequest).
PowerPanel
Power panel: battery charge, screen backlight brightness and the hardware temperature sensors, over the BatteryStatus, BrightnessStatus and ThermalService seams.
PrintingPanel
Printing panel: lists the CUPS printer queues, marks the system default, and offers the two management actions that do not need a full spooler UI - make a queue the default and submit a test page.
PrivacyPanel
The Security Center's Privacy section (LFS/BLFS system-management contract §4.7): a thin front-end over the shared PrivacyService.
ProcessTableModel
Table model binding ProcessService snapshots to the task manager's process table.
ProjectCard
The Project card (Espresso "Projet" menu): create, open and manage project folders from inside the editor.
ProjectCard.Host
The panel-side callbacks for the project card.
ProtocolListener
The callback surface a MessengerProtocol uses to push asynchronous events back to the client.
ProtocolRegistry
The catalogue of chat backends the Messenger can use, and the factory that builds a fresh instance per connection (backends such as IrcProtocol are stateful, so each account gets its own).
ProtocolRegistry.ProtocolInfo
Metadata + factory for one registered backend.
QuickLaunchPanel
Quick Launch panel: edits the pinned shortcut strip on the conventional Swing (2D) desktop's taskbar - the equivalent of the 3D taskbar's shortcut shelf - over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
ReaderArticle
An article extracted for reader mode: a title, an optional byline and the body paragraphs, all as plain text.
ReaderExtractor
Reader mode: a small readability-style extractor plus the clean, ad-free page it renders.
RecentCard
The Recent Files card: the persisted list of recently opened paths, shown in-panel (a JList, never a popup menu, so it presents correctly inside the 3D desktop's offscreen capture).
RecentCard.Host
The panel-side callbacks for the recent-files card.
ReconnectPolicy
The pure auto-reconnect backoff policy.
Recorder
The audio/video recorder application: the RecorderPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
Recorder
Recorder.java
RecorderBackend
The AWT-free recording seam.
RecorderClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the recorder panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.recorder.RecorderClient).
RecorderPanel
The recorder's user interface: an Audio tab that captures the microphone natively to WAV, a Screen tab that captures the X11 display through an external ffmpeg/avconv, and a history list of finished captures on the right.
RecorderStore
JSON persistence for the recorder's preferences and capture history.
Recording
One finished recording in the history: an absolute file path, whether it is an audio (WAV) or video (screen) capture, an approximate duration and a title.
Recording.Kind
Whether the capture is audio-only or a screen recording.
RecordingSettings
The recorder's persisted preferences: where captures are written, the audio capture format, and the screen-recording source / resolution / frame rate.
RectangleTool
Axis-aligned rectangle dragged out corner to corner; filled and/or stroked.
RemoteViewer
The Remote Viewer application (ported from the standalone jrdesktop / Remote Viewer RMI remote-desktop tool): the original RemoteViewerPanel Swing UI (server start/stop, status, viewer connect, file transfer, about, exit - unchanged from the upstream MainFrame) presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, exactly like every other hosted lg3d application (Password Manager, Docker Manager, Paint, ...).
RemoteViewerPanel
The original jrdesktop/Remote Viewer main GUI (server controls, status, viewer connect, about, exit), unchanged in content and layout from the standalone application.
ResizeDialog
The Image → Resize dialog: a new pixel width/height with an optional keep-aspect-ratio lock.
RipSettings
The audio player's persisted CD-ripping preferences: the output format (MP3 or WAV), the target sampling rate, the MP3 bitrate, the destination folder, the CD device, and optional preferred ripper / encoder executables (blank means auto-detect on the PATH).

RotateDialog
The Image → Rotate dialog: quick 90/180/-90 presets and an arbitrary angle spinner.

ScanRecord
One finished scan in the history: what was scanned, with which scanner, how long it took, how many files were walked and how many threats were found.
ScanReport
The parsed result of one ClamAV scan, produced by AntivirusBackend.parseScanOutput(java.util.List<java.lang.String>, int) from the scanner's combined stdout/stderr and its exit code.
SchedulePanel
Schedule panel: two independent schedules that no longer share any control.
ScreenCaptureConfigFrame
 
ScreenPlayer

Search
The Advanced Search application: the SearchPanel presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the Swing panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
SearchEngine
The pure search-and-replace engine behind the editor's Find bar: literal or regular-expression matching, optional case sensitivity, forward/backward navigation with wrap-around, match counting and replace-one / replace-all.
SearchEngine
The search engines the smart address bar can fall back to when the typed text is not a URL (see UrlNormalizer).
SearchEngine.Match
One search hit: the [start, end) span of a match.
SearchEngine.ReplaceResult
The outcome of a replace-all: the new text and the replacement count.
SearchPanel
The Advanced Search panel: a production file-and-content finder for the desktop and the (minimal) LFS system.
SecureChannel
A single encrypted, authenticated, reliable peer-to-peer link over one TCP socket.
SecureChannel.Listener
Receives decoded frames and lifecycle events, on the reader thread.
SecureFrame
One unit of transport traffic: a type plus an opaque payload.
SecureFrame.Type
The kind of payload a frame carries; also its one-byte wire tag and AAD.
SecurityCenter
The Antivirus / Security Center application: the SecurityCenterPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
SecurityCenterClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the Security Center panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.securitycenter.SecurityCenterClient).
SecurityCenterPanel
The Security Center's user interface: an Antivirus tab that scans a chosen target through an installed ClamAV, a Security Overview tab that aggregates the host's SELinux / firewall / AppArmor / SSH / antivirus posture, a Privacy tab (PrivacyPanel) that drives the tor service and shows its read-only config and log, and a scan history dock on the right.
SecurityCenterSettings
The Security Center's persisted preferences: what to scan, whether to walk directories, whether to quarantine (move, never delete) infected files, which ClamAV scanner to prefer, and whether to refresh definitions / the overview automatically.
SecurityCenterStore
JSON persistence for the Security Center's preferences, scan history and append-only activity log.
SecurityInfo
Classifies a URL's connection security for the address-bar indicator and the site-info popup: SecurityInfo.Level.SECURE (https), SecurityInfo.Level.NOT_SECURE (http/ftp), SecurityInfo.Level.LOCAL (file or loopback host), SecurityInfo.Level.INTERNAL (about/data/blob/view-source/javascript) or SecurityInfo.Level.UNKNOWN.
SecurityInfo.Level
The connection-security level of a URL.
SecurityProbe
The AWT-free host-security seam for the Security Overview.
SecurityProbe.FirewallState
The firewalld running state reported by firewall-cmd --state.
SecurityProbe.SelinuxMode
The SELinux enforcement mode reported by getenforce.
SecurityScore
The pure, weighted security checklist behind the Overview grade.
SecurityScore.Grade
The letter grade bands over the 0-100 weighted percentage.
SecurityScore.Item
One weighted checklist line: what was checked, whether it passed, the points it is worth and a short human detail for the findings list.
SecurityScore.Result
The computed score: the earned points, the maximum, the letter grade and the per-item findings, in checklist order.
SecuritySnapshot
The host's aggregated security posture shown on the Security Overview tab: the SELinux mode, the firewall state, whether an antivirus scanner is installed (and which one), the ClamAV engine / database version, the private (Tor) mode state and whether a VPN tunnel is up (with its kill switch armed).
Selection
A document-space selection: an axis-aligned bounding Rectangle plus an optional per-pixel mask.
SelectLassoTool
Freeform (lasso) selection.
SelectRectTool
Rectangular marquee selection.

ServicesPanel
Service management panel (Phase 1 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.1).
SettingsCard
The Settings card: an in-panel form (shown through the editor's centre CardLayout) rather than a modal dialog, for the same reason as the find bar — a dialog would escape the 3D desktop's SwingNode capture.
SettingsCard.Host
The panel-side callbacks for OK / Cancel.
ShapeTool
Base for the drag-out two-point shapes (line, rectangle, ellipse).
ShareOperations
Read-only network sharing for the file manager: serves a folder over HTTP so other machines on the LAN can browse and download it, using the JDK's built-in com.sun.net.httpserver.
ShareOperations.Share
A running HTTP folder share.
ShortcutsPanel
Shortcuts panel: rebinds the 2D desktop's global keyboard shortcuts.
SiteStats
Per-site counters of what the browser's protections blocked, shown in the site-info popup: navigations blocked and popups blocked, keyed by host.
SiteStats.Counts
An immutable snapshot of one host's blocked counts.
SmartIndent
Pure auto-indent logic: given the text of the line the caret is on, compute the indent the next line should get.
SnippetsTools
The bundled "Insert & Snippets" extension (Espresso Phase 6): one-tap insertion of the small boilerplate people constantly retype — a UUID, a timestamp in three flavours, an ISO date, a lorem-ipsum line and a random hex colour.
SoundPanel
Sound panel: a master output volume JSlider and mute toggle, plus a list of the host's output devices (sinks/cards) that can be inspected and switched, all over the VolumeStatus seam.

SourceWindow
Very very preliminary help app whcih just shows the usage guide on the screen.
SprayTool
An airbrush: each gesture event scatters a burst of single-pixel dots at random within a circular spray whose radius follows the tool's stroke width.
Spring
 
SpringBootTools
The bundled "Spring Boot Tools" extension: helpers for the configuration idioms a Spring Boot project lives on — converting between the flat, dot-notation application.properties and the nested application.yml, normalising property keys to Spring Boot's canonical kebab-case (relaxed binding), and listing every ${...} placeholder a document references — registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI under the Spring category.
Ssh
The SSH client application: the SshPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
SshPanel
Production SSH client panel: tabbed multi-session terminal with connection profiles, ANSI terminal emulation, keepalive, port forwarding, and full host-key verification.
SshProfile
A saved SSH connection profile: everything needed to reach one remote host.
SshProfile.AuthMethod
Authentication method.
SshProfileStore
JSON persistence for SshProfile connection profiles and application settings.
SshProfileStore.SshSettings
Application-wide SSH client settings persisted as JSON.
SshSession
Manages a single SSH connection lifecycle: connect, shell I/O, keepalive, port forwarding, and graceful disconnect.
SshSession.Listener
Listener for session events (output, state changes, errors).
SshSession.State
Connection states.
SshSwingClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the SSH client panel.
SshTerminalPanel
A lightweight ANSI/VT100 terminal emulator component for Swing.
SshTerminalPanel.InputListener
Callback for key input to send to the remote shell.
StatusBar
The bottom status strip: pointer coordinates, zoom percentage, document size and a hint for the active tool.

StoragePanel
Storage & LUKS panel (Phase 3 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.5).
StoredMessage
One persisted transcript line, keyed to an account and a conversation target.
StructureSymbol
One entry in a document's structural outline (a type, method, field or other named member), reported by an analysis extension through EditorContext.showStructure(java.lang.String, java.util.List<org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.StructureSymbol>) and rendered in the Structure panel.
SwingIde
Start-Menu launcher for the external swing-ide project: a full-featured modular Java Swing IDE (code editor, build tools, Git, debugger, database explorer, plugins…) that ships as a self-contained fat jar (libs/swing-ide.jar).
SwingNodeTest
Put a simple Swing UI in the LG environment
SwingNodeTutorial
Put a simple Swing UI in the LG environment
SyntaxHighlighter
The Advanced Text Editor's syntax colouriser: a small, dependency-free scanner that turns text into SyntaxHighlighter.Tokens according to a declarative Language, plus a batch applier that paints those tokens onto a StyledDocument with an EditorTheme's colours.
SyntaxHighlighter.Token
One lexed token: a [start, start + length) span classified as kind.
SystemInfoPanel
System / About panel backed by SystemInfoService: CPU, memory, per-mount disk usage, kernel, distro, hostname, uptime, session and user, with live-updating CPU and memory gauges and a manual Refresh.
SystemUpdatePanel
Whole-system update panel (Phase 2 of the LFS system-management contract, system-management-contract.md §4.2).

TaskManager

TaskManagerPanel
The task manager's Swing UI: a live, sortable, filterable process table with an aggregate load header, a details pane for the selected process, and End Task (SIGTERM) / Force Quit (SIGKILL) / Change Priority (renice) actions.
TaskSchedulerPanel
Task Scheduler panel: the desktop's crontab.
Terminator

TrackerBlockerExtension
A first-party reference extension that vetoes navigations to a small bundled list of well-known tracker/ad hosts, and (when granted Permission.CONTENT_SCRIPT) hides the common ad containers on the rendered page.
TrustDecision
The pure verdict of a trust-on-first-use (TOFU) check: given the fingerprint we have pinned for a peer (if any) and the one it actually presented during the NoiseXXHandshake, decide whether to proceed, warn, or refuse.
Tuner
The guitar / bass tuner application: the TunerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
TunerClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the tuner panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.tuner.TunerClient).
TunerPanel
The guitar / bass tuner's Swing face: a live cent-deviation meter, the detected note, and a strip of the selected tuning's strings with the nearest one highlighted.
Tuning
A named instrument tuning: an ordered set of target notes (low string to high) with the equal-tempered reference frequency of each, plus the search that maps a detected pitch to the nearest string and its deviation in cents.
TuningMeter
The tuner's cent-deviation meter: a horizontal scale from flat (-) through in tune (0) to sharp (+) with a needle that eases toward the current reading and turns green inside the tolerance window.
TuningStore
JSON persistence for the tuner's user-defined tunings (the built-in guitar/bass sets in Tuning.ALL are compiled in and never written here).
TunnelVerdict
The outcome of a tunnel leak check.

UndoStack<T>
A bounded undo / redo stack of immutable state snapshots.
UpdateManager
The Software Update application: the update-manager module's Swing update pipeline presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the UpdateManagerPanel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
UpdateManagerPanel
The Software Update content: the update-manager module's Swing update pipeline (check / download / verify / install, plus channel and scheduling settings) presented as a self-contained panel.
UrlNormalizer
The smart address bar's resolution logic, isolated from any UI so it can be unit-tested headless.
UsersPanel
User administration panel backed by UserService: lists local accounts (optionally including system accounts), shows their details and group membership, and performs add / edit / set-password / groups / remove through pkexec.
VaultCrypto
The AWT-free cryptographic seam of the Password Manager.
VaultCrypto.Strength
How strong VaultCrypto.strength(String) judges a candidate password to be.
VaultEnvelope
The sealed vault as it is stored on disk: a PBKDF2 iteration count, a random salt, a GCM IV and the AES-GCM ciphertext of the whole vault JSON, each binary field Base64-encoded so the envelope is a plain Jackson bean (VaultStore round-trips it as vault.json).
VaultStore
JSON persistence for the Password Manager: the sealed VaultEnvelope (vault.json) and the plaintext PasswordManagerSettings (settings.json).
VersionInfo
The ClamAV engine and virus-database versions parsed from clamscan --version, which prints a single line such as ClamAV 1.4.6/27171/Wed Jan 31 04:46:17 2024.
VideoBackend
The AWT-free video playback seam.
VideoConference
The Video Conference application: the VideoConferencePanel Jitsi Meet client presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
VideoConferenceClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the video-conference panel, for running the client outside the desktop (e.g.
VideoConferencePanel
The Video Conference application's Swing face: a Jitsi Meet conference client.
VideoConferenceSettings
Application-wide video-conference preferences, persisted as JSON by VideoConferenceStore and consulted by JitsiUrlBuilder when a room does not override an option.
VideoConferenceSettings.LaunchMode
How the meeting session is launched.
VideoConferenceStore
JSON persistence for the video-conference client: saved rooms, the recent-call history and the VideoConferenceSettings.
VideoItem
One entry of the video player's library: a local movie file, a network stream URL, or an optical disc device.
VideoItem.Kind
What an entry points at.
VideoPlayer
The video player application: the VideoPlayerPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
VideoPlayerClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the video player panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.videoplayer.VideoPlayerClient).
VideoPlayerPanel
The video player's user interface, a VLC-style front-end: a library on the left, a now-playing display with launch controls in the centre, and player / volume / full-screen preferences along the bottom.
VideoPlayerStore
JSON persistence for the video player's library and preferences.
VideoSettings
The video player's persisted preferences: master volume, an optional preferred external player (blank means auto-detect), and whether to start the external player full-screen.
Viewer
 
ViewerData
ViewerData.java
ViewerGUI
The standalone (CLI viewer mode) host for the Remote Viewer: a thin JFrame wrapper around the shared ViewerPanel.
ViewerHost
Hosts the Remote Viewer's live-viewing panel (Recorder.viewerPanel) inside whichever desktop is running, so the viewer window belongs to the desktop and is captured by the desktop screenshot instead of escaping it as a stray top-level OS window beside the desktop.
ViewerPanel
The Remote Viewer's live-viewing UI (toolbar + the ScreenPlayer that shows the remote screen) as a plain JPanel with no window chrome.
VolumeOperations
Removable-volume operations for the file manager: enumerate mountable block devices and mount / unmount them, shelling out to the standard Linux tools.
VolumeOperations.OpResult
The outcome of a mount / unmount attempt.
VolumeOperations.Volume
A mountable block device / partition discovered by lsblk.
Vpn
The VPN client application: the VpnPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
VpnBackend
The AWT-free VPN seam.
VpnClient
Standalone JFrame wrapper for the VPN panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.vpn.VpnClient).
VpnPanel
The VPN client's user interface: a profile dock (NetworkManager connections discovered live, plus OpenVPN/WireGuard configs the user imports), a detail / status centre with Connect and Disconnect, and a backend picker.
VpnProfile
One VPN connection the app can bring up.
VpnSettings
The VPN client's persisted preferences: which tunnel tool to prefer, whether to connect the last profile automatically on open, which profile that was, and whether to re-read the live connection state when the panel opens.
VpnStatus
The live tunnel state the panel renders: whether a VPN is up, which profile and network device carry it, and a short human detail line.
VpnStore
JSON persistence for the VPN client's preferences and imported profiles.
Weather
The Weather application: the WeatherPanel current-conditions and forecast reader presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow, which hosts the panel on a SwingNode quad below a draggable glassy title bar.
WeatherPanel
The Weather application's Swing face: a full window showing the current conditions and a six-day forecast for a chosen city, fed by the AWT-free OpenMeteo backend (the same free Open-Meteo API the desktop Weather widget uses, over the JDK java.net.http client with a dependency-free JSON reader — no third-party library).
WebBrowser
The Web Browser application's 3D-desktop entry point (Start Menu → Internet → Web Browser).
WebBrowserApp
The full browser as a top-level JFrame: a BrowserPanel in its own window.
WebIcon
A sample 3D icon
WebIcon2
A sample 3D icon
WebTools
The bundled "Web Tools" extension: conversion helpers for web/XML-oriented text, registered through the public TextEditorExtension SPI and grouped under the Web category.
WorkspacesPanel
Workspaces panel: how many virtual desktops the 2D shell offers, which one is shown, and how many windows sit on each, over the Desktop2D control-center hooks.
